body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm a data scientist with 4+ years shipping production ML systems -- behavioral anomaly detection pipelines, transformer-based NLP classifiers, RAG-based AI assistants, and full A/B testing and causal inference frameworks -- and I'm applying for the Senior Data Scientist role at Teramind.

Teramind is building intelligent workforce analytics on top of millions of behavioral signals. That's exactly the kind of high-stakes, signal-rich ML problem I want to be solving -- where the gap between a well-designed model and a weak one shows up in real product decisions.

What I'd bring on day one: behavioral signal modeling and anomaly detection aren't resume bullets for me -- they're core to how I've built things that actually shipped. At Kameleon, I built a real-time anomaly detection system combining graph-based models (Neo4j) with XGBoost and Random Forest ensembles that processed 5M+ daily behavioral signals and cut false positives by 18%. At Community Dreams Foundation, I owned a full transformer-based RAG pipeline (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Gemini Pro) from raw signals through production -- including the experimentation framework that tracked accuracy, deflection rate, and latency and drove a 22% accuracy improvement over three iterations.

The work I'd point to as most directly relevant: the fraud detection and anomaly detection system at Kameleon is structurally identical to what Teramind is building -- high-frequency behavioral signals, ensemble models, production deployment, and continuous retraining on drift. I've run that full lifecycle and know where the subtle failure modes are.

I'm the kind of hire who can scope, prototype, productionize, and monitor without needing a long ramp-up. My portfolio is at rohitananthan.info if you want to see how I approach these problems end to end.

Would love to connect.

Rohit Ananthan
rohitananthan123@gmail.com  |  linkedin.com/in/rohit-ananthan  |  rohitananthan.info
